pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients at edges. Morphology is predominantly polygonal with larger spatial area on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the posterior and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space pathways appear as light-colored, continuous lines of moderate pixel thickness. Topological graph shows frequent tri-radial and quad-radial junction nodes with high connectivity across the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: 1D contour along the dorsal neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated pattern of dark pixels against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) are localized on the dorsal ridge of the neck and upper shoulder region.
